DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「店の前」と送ったのですが、友人が別の店を見ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店前だけでは友人と会えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I sent a message saying I was in front of the shop, but my friend is looking at a different shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that saying only in front of the shop has not helped you meet your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この店の名前は伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you told them this shop's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。同じ色の看板があるので、色だけではわからないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 看板色だけの不確かな案内を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. There are signs of the same color, so the color alone isn't enough to identify it, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your uncertain directions based only on the sign's color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店名の入った表示がこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a sign with the shop's name here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これを伝えます。入口に集まらず、横の広い所で待ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店名連絡と入口外での待機を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell them this name. May I wait in the wider space at the side instead of gathering at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the shop name and ask to wait away from the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けていただければ大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's fine as long as you keep the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人には移動を続けず、今いる店名を返してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の現在店名を尋ねる方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll ask my friend to stop moving around and send me the name of the shop they're currently at.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask for the name of your friend's current shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Were you able to contact them?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取れました。私がここで待つと伝えたので、行き違いを防げそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分は動かず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I told them I'd wait here, so we should be able to avoid missing each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will stay where you are and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、通行の妨げにならない位置でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait somewhere that doesn't obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二人前をご用意しますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いえ、二人で少しずつ食べたいので、単品で頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人前でなく単品注文を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, we'd like to eat a little at a time between the two of us. Can we order individual items?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request individual items rather than two servings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。お好みをお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please tell me what you would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は白身を二つお願いします。二人前ではなく、握りを二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 握り数を人数と区別して指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: First, two pieces of white-fish nigiri, please. Two pieces of nigiri, not two servings.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the number of nigiri pieces separately from the number of people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つで承りました。次も一度に出しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Two pieces, understood. Shall I bring the next items at the same time too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次は食べてから決めます。先に全部並ぶと、量がわからなくなるので。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食後に追加を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll decide what to have next after eating. If everything is laid out first, we'll lose track of the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will decide on additions after eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み物はお二人とも同じでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you both like the same drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私はお茶、友人は水でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各人の飲み物を分けて注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tea for me and water for my friend, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Order each person's drink separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 握り二つと、お茶・水ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: So that's two nigiri pieces, tea and water?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。取り分ける皿も一枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取り分け皿を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Could we also have one plate for sharing?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a sharing plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お皿をお持ちします。まず白身二つからご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll bring a plate. We'll start by preparing the two white-fish pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付票はお受け取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you received your reception slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。診察券と違う番号があります。どちらが呼ばれるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二種類の番号の呼出用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It has a different number from my patient card. Which one will be called?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two kinds of numbers is used for calling patients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この受付票の番号でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll call you using the number on this reception slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、診察券の番号が出るのを待つ必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待つ番号を言い換えて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I don't need to wait for my patient-card number to appear, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Rephrase and confirm the number you should wait for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。受付票はお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Please keep your reception slip with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行する母にも、その番号を知らせておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行母への番号共有を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my mother, who's accompanying me, that number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will share the number with your accompanying mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お母様が代わりに診察を受けるわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your mother isn't receiving the consultation instead of you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。診察は私です。母は付き添いで、番号を一緒に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 患者本人と付添人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I'm the patient. My mother is accompanying me, and we'll watch for the number together.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the patient from the accompanying person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 呼ばれたら診察券もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you're called, please bring your patient card too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。二つを別の物として、両方持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付票と診察券を両方保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll treat them as two separate items and wait with both of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep both the reception slip and patient card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの待合席でお待ちください。ご案内する番号は受付票の方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait in these waiting seats. The number we'll use is the one on the reception slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。大きな紙幣しかありません。少額の買物ですが使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 少額購入で高額紙幣利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me, I only have a large banknote. Can I use it even though it's a small purchase?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using a large banknote for a small purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 釣銭を確認します。別のお支払い方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the change. Do you have another way to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードもあります。釣銭が足りなければ、カードで払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 釣銭不足時のカード代替を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a card too. If you don't have enough change, I'll pay by card.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Offer card payment as an alternative if change is insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両替だけのご希望ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You're not asking just to change the note, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。この飲み物を買います。紙幣を崩すために商品を増やすつもりもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 買物目的と両替目的を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I'm buying this drink. I don't intend to add products just to break the note either.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish making a purchase from asking for change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードでのお支払いも可能です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can pay by card too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではカードにします。差し込む機械はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード決済端末を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll use my card. Is this the machine I insert it into?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check which terminal to use for card payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。金額を確認して操作してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the amount before operating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示額を確認しました。操作が終わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面金額を確認し完了を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the displayed amount. I'll wait until the process is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the screen amount and wait for completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 完了しました。カードと商品をお忘れなくお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's completed. Please remember to take your card and purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 中身はどのようなお品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of items are inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さな道具です。持ってきた時に中で動く音がしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱内の移動音を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: They're small tools. I heard them moving inside when I brought the box here.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report hearing movement inside the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 隙間を埋めるなど、包装を見直していただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You'll need to review the packaging, such as filling the gaps.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで開けてもよいですか。まだ発送の受付はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開梱許可と受付保留を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I open it here? Please don't accept it for shipping yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask permission to open the box and hold off on acceptance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作業できる場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you somewhere you can work.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。道具の向きを揃えるだけでは、まだ動きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 向きの修正だけでは不十分と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. It looks like they'll still move even if I simply align the tools in the same direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that changing the orientation alone is insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 補強する物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any materials for reinforcing the packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。一度持ち帰って、隙間を埋めてから出し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 補強材不足で持ち帰る判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I'll take it home, fill the gaps and bring it back for shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to take it home because you lack reinforcement materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送り状は先にお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can give you the shipping label in advance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。宛先を家で書いて、箱と一緒にまた持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送り状を先に受け取り再持参を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll write the address at home and bring it back with the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the shipping label first and say you will bring it back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが送り状です。包装を整えてから、改めて窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the shipping label. Please bring it to the desk again after improving the packaging.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りなさい。足元に何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome back. Is there a problem with your footwear?

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い靴が片方ありません。岩場へ行く前に、砂浜で脱いだと思います。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片方の青い靴を砂浜で脱いだ経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-02.translation: One of my blue shoes is missing. I think I took them off on the beach before going to the rocks.
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how you took off the missing blue shoe on the beach. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に靴をそろえた場所を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where you last put the shoes together?

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い旗の向こうにある流木の横です。今から取りに行ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 流木と赤い旗を目印に紛失場所を示し立ち入りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside the driftwood beyond the red flag. May I go and get it now?
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the lost location using driftwood and a red flag and ask whether you may enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その旗より先は立ち入らないでください。こちらから監視員に、岸側で捜せるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't go beyond that flag. I'll ask the lifeguard whether they can search from the shore side.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分では旗を越えずに待ちます。靴の特徴も伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旗を越えず待つと伝え靴の特徴の伝達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait without crossing the flag myself. Could you also tell them what the shoe looks like?
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait without crossing the flag and ask for the shoe's features to be passed on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、青い靴ですね。見つかったときに区別できる印はありますか。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, a blue shoe. Is there a mark to distinguish it if it's found?

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かかとに白い星の絵があります。右足用で、サイズは二十六です。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白い星の印と右足用二十六センチを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a white star on the heel. It's the right shoe, size twenty-six centimeters.
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the white star mark and say it is a right shoe, size twenty-six centimeters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 特徴を伝えました。監視員から返事が来るまで、こちらの椅子でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've passed on the description. Please wait in this chair until the lifeguard replies.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では椅子で待っています。見つからなければ、帰るときの履き物を相談させてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 椅子で待ち発見できない場合の帰路の履き物を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll wait in the chair. If it isn't found, please let me ask about footwear for the trip home.
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait in the chair and ask about footwear for going home if the shoe cannot be found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずは休んでお待ちください、それでは後ほど。
DLG-SC-TTR-IWAMI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. For now, please rest and wait. I'll see you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: テントの設営は進んでいますか。夕方の雨の予報が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is setting up your tent going? Rain is forecast for this evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ骨組みだけです。雨の中で片付ける自信がないので、今日は帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 設営途中で雨に備え宿泊を取りやめたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've only put up the frame so far. I'm not confident about packing up in the rain, so I'd like to go home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to cancel your overnight stay during setup because of the approaching rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承りました。火を使ったり、荷物を区画の外へ置いたりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Have you used fire or put any belongings outside your plot?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 火は使っていません。袋から出したテントと道具だけを区画に置いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 火を使用しておらず区画にはテントと道具だけあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't used fire. Only the tent and tools I've taken out of their bags are in the plot.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not used fire and the plot contains only the tent and tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、乾いているうちに収納してください。車は通路を塞がない場所へ移動できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please pack them while they're dry. Can you move your car somewhere that doesn't block the passage?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物が重いので、車を入口側へ寄せてから運びたいです。停める位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物運搬のため車を寄せる停車位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The luggage is heavy, so I'd like to bring the car closer to the entrance before carrying it. Please tell me where to stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to bring the car to carry the luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付前の停車スペースへご案内します。撤収後は、使った区画を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you the stopping space in front of reception. After packing up, let's check the plot you used together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さなペグをなくしやすいので、本数を数えてから区画を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ペグを数えた後に区画を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The small pegs are easy to lose, so could you check the plot after I've counted them?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the plot to be checked after counting the pegs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。料金の扱いについても、お申し込みの内容を確認してからご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. We'll also explain the fee arrangements after checking the details of your booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約した名前はグエンです。片付けが終わったら、その名前で受付へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約名グエンを伝え撤収後受付に戻ると約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The booking name is Nguyen. Once I've finished packing up, I'll return to reception under that name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the booking name Nguyen and say you will return to reception after packing up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: グエン様ですね。足元に気を付けて片付けてください、それではまた受付で。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nguyen, understood. Please watch your step while packing up. I'll see you at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その焼き菓子は薄いので、持ち運ぶときにつぶれやすい商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Those baked sweets are thin, so they're easily crushed while being carried.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電車で帰るのでリュックに入れたいです。柔らかい袋より、箱入りはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電車でリュックに入れて運ぶため焼き菓子の箱入りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going home by train and would like to put them in my backpack. Do you have a boxed version rather than a soft bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for boxed baked sweets for carrying in a backpack on the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ味の箱入りがこちらです。袋入りより数が多くなりますが、何人にお渡しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here's a boxed version of the same flavor. It contains more than the bagged version; how many people will you give them to?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 職場の五人に配ります。一人ずつ渡せるように、個別の袋に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五人に配る予定を伝え個包装か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll give them to five people at work. Are they individually wrapped so I can hand them out one by one?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say they are for five people and check individual wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、中は一枚ずつ包装されています。箱の大きさがリュックに入るか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, each piece is wrapped separately. Let's check whether the box fits in your backpack.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横幅は入りますが、ほかの荷物を上に載せそうです。箱の底に厚紙を添えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物の圧力が心配なため箱底への厚紙追加を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The width fits, but I might put other luggage on top. Could you add thick cardboard under the box?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for cardboard beneath the box because you are concerned about pressure from luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装用の厚紙を一枚お付けできます。ただ、強い圧力がかからないように入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can include one piece of packaging cardboard. However, please pack it so it isn't exposed to strong pressure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 重い水筒は別の袋へ移します。値札は外して、厚紙を一緒に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水筒を別に移すと伝え値札の除去と厚紙の同梱を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move my heavy water bottle to another bag. Please remove the price tag and put the cardboard in with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will move the water bottle separately and request removal of the price tag and inclusion of cardboard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 値札を外しました。こちらの箱でよろしければ、お会計に進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've removed the price tag. If this box is okay, we'll proceed to payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この箱を買います。配るまで開けないので、外側に味を書いてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を購入すると決め外側への味の記載を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll buy this box. I won't open it until I hand them out, so it would help if you could write the flavor on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to buy the box and ask for the flavor to be written outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 味が分かる札を付けました。お土産が無事に届きますように、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've attached a tag identifying the flavor. I hope your gifts arrive safely. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物のお花をお探しでしょうか。置く場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for flowers as a gift? Have you decided where they'll be placed?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自宅で療養している友人の枕元に置きたいです。花瓶がなくても飾れるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 療養中の友人の枕元用に花瓶不要の花を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to put them beside the bed of a friend recovering at home. Is there something they can display without a vase?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for flowers that need no vase to place beside a recovering friend's bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さな器に生けたものがあります。台の広さと、持って行くまでの時間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have arrangements in small containers. Please tell me the space available and how long it will take to deliver them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台は本一冊くらいの広さです。ここから歩いて十五分ほどで届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本一冊程度の置き場所と徒歩十五分の移動を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The stand has about the space of one book. I'll deliver them on foot in about fifteen minutes from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the space is about one book and the walk takes fifteen minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この低い器なら置きやすそうです。香りや色について、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This low container looks easy to place there. Do you have preferences for scent or color?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は強い香りが苦手です。白だけだと寂しいので、淡い黄色も入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 香りを弱くし白に淡い黄色を加える希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend dislikes strong scents. White alone feels a little sad, so please add pale yellow too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a mild scent and pale yellow alongside white. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 香りの弱い候補を選んで組み合わせます。器を含めたご予算はいくらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll choose and combine lightly scented options. What's your budget including the container?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三千円以内でお願いします。紙袋の中で器が傾かないようにしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 器込み三千円以内と転倒を防ぐ包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Within three thousand yen, please. Could you pack it so the container doesn't tip inside the paper bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give a budget within three thousand yen including the container and request packaging against tipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 器の底を固定してお包みします。水を足す場所はこちらなので、説明の紙も添えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll secure the base of the container and wrap it. This is where water is added, so I'll include an instruction sheet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙があると友人にも伝わります。水の足し方と一緒に、短い見舞いのカードも入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水の説明の紙を受け取り見舞いカードの同封を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: A sheet will help me explain it to my friend too. Along with the watering instructions, I'd like to include a short get-well card.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the watering instruction sheet and ask to include a get-well card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: カードをご記入ください、仕上がったらお渡しします。どうぞ大切にお持ちください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please fill in the card. We'll give it to you when it's ready. Please carry it carefully, and thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票をお預かりする前に、空いている欄を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before I take your medical questionnaire, let's check the blank fields together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲んでいる薬の欄が空白です。毎朝一錠飲みますが、名前を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 毎朝一錠服用するが薬名を知らないため問診欄が空白だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The medication field is blank. I take one tablet every morning, but I don't remember its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the medication field is blank because you take one tablet each morning but do not know its name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬の袋やお薬手帳はお持ちですか。分からない名前を推測して書く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the medication bag or your medication record book? You don't need to guess an unknown name and write it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手帳は家にあります。袋を撮った写真なら、携帯に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬手帳は自宅にあり携帯には薬袋の写真があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The record book is at home. I do have a photo of the medication bag on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the medication record book is at home and your phone has a photo of the medicine bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見してもよろしいですか。写真の文字が読めなければ、担当者へ名前が不明だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: May I see it? If the photo text isn't readable, I'll tell the staff member the name is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この写真です。端が切れていて、薬の名前は最後の二文字しか見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真の薬名が切れて二文字しか写らないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the photo. The edge is cut off, so only the last two characters of the medication name are visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that the medication name is cut off in the photo and only two characters appear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: これだけでは特定できませんね。何のために処方されていると説明されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't identify it from that alone. What were you told it was prescribed for?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 血圧のためと聞きました。今朝も飲んだことを、名前が不明なことと一緒に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 血圧目的の薬を今朝服用し薬名不明だと担当者への伝達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was told it was for blood pressure. Please tell them I took it this morning too, together with the fact that the name is unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member to be told that you took blood-pressure medication this morning and its name is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方を担当者に伝えます。あとで手帳を確認できたら、記録を補えるか受付に相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on both points. If you can check the record book later, ask reception whether the record can be supplemented.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰宅したら手帳を確認します。連絡するときは、今日の健診の受付番号を伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅後の薬手帳確認を約束し連絡時に使う受付番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the book when I get home. When I contact you, should I give the reception number for today's health check?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the medication book at home and ask which reception number to use when contacting them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付で番号と連絡方法をご確認ください。それでは、問診票を持って受付へどうぞ、お気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm the number and contact method at reception. Then take the questionnaire to reception. Take care.
